workspaceHint: Studio access requires an approved owner membership. Choosing a business account does not create a workspace.
emptyReceipts: Your campaign reactions will appear here
followHint: Receive broadcasts from this business. You can opt out at any time.
unfollowBody: Pending broadcasts will expire and your reactions will no longer be featured.
title: Campaign title
mediaHint: Choose the media to include in this campaign.
publishBody: Send to the current opt-in followers ({{count}}). One campaign per UTC day. Media and audience cannot be edited after publication.
retryBody: Retry only the original audience and media; no new audience is added.
closeBody: Pending deliveries will be cancelled. Existing consented reactions can remain in the gallery.
deleteBody: This draft will be permanently removed.
rateHint: Delivery rate uses the audience snapshot; other rates use delivered recipients.
pinHint: Up to six reactions per business, only with explicit consent.
previewOnly: This is a campaign preview. Only delivered recipients can record a reaction or contribute delivery metrics.
consent: Allow this business to feature my reaction on its profile and gallery for other signed-in users to see.
consentHint: Optional. Leave unchecked to keep this reaction out of the public gallery.
storageNotice: Reactions use public media links. Withdrawal removes gallery visibility, but cannot invalidate copied links or downloaded files.
noOwnReaction: No reaction submitted for this campaign
recordHint: Record a video reaction, up to 30 seconds.
permissionBody: Allow camera and microphone access to record a reaction.
error: Could not complete this action. Please try again.
permissionError: Camera or media-library permission is required.
invalidCampaign: Choose media and enter a title (1–120 characters).
unavailable: This campaign is no longer available.
accountHint: Business Studio is available only to approved pilot owners; this selection does not grant access.
